profile.professional_summary: Career switcher moving from five years in manufacturing quality and process engineering into entry-level data science and machine learning. Used statistical process control, root-cause analysis and production KPI reporting professionally; recently built portfolio projects with Python, pandas, SQL and scikit-learn on equipment sensor data and plant defect rates. Strong industrial-domain knowledge and tabular-data skills, but no professional model-deployment, NLP, cloud or production ML experience. Seeking a first dedicated data/ML role.

projects.name: Equipment Fault Prediction
projects.summary: Portfolio project using simulated factory sensor measurements to predict equipment faults with Python and scikit-learn. Compared baseline models, engineered rolling-window sensor features and checked leakage.
highlights: Combined engineering domain knowledge with sensor-based feature engineering.
Used train/test splits, precision-recall curves and error analysis.
Documented limitations of synthetic sensor data; no production deployment.

projects.name: Factory Yield and Quality Analytics
projects.summary: Built a portfolio SQL and Python analysis of synthetic production batches, quality inspections and defect rates with management-facing KPI summaries.
highlights: Analyzed defect trends using statistical summaries and root-cause hypotheses.
Built reproducible extracts and a quality KPI dashboard.
Described confounding and the limits of causal interpretation.

details: Focused on manufacturing processes, measurements and quality engineering.

job.title: Graduate Machine Learning Engineer - Predictive Maintenance
job.description: Build Python and scikit-learn fault classifiers from equipment sensor readings. Engineer time-window features, evaluate precision and recall and work with engineers on dataset quality. Model deployment training is provided. Hybrid in Munich.

jobs.notes: Graduate-level equipment-fault ML strongly matches engineering background and portfolio evidence.

job.title: Junior Machine Learning Engineer - Credit Risk
job.description: Create Python and scikit-learn models for tabular credit-risk features. Test validation splits, document errors and work with specialists on responsible deployment. Financial-regulation and model-serving experience is beneficial. Hybrid in Berlin.

jobs.notes: Substantial transferable tabular ML, offset by absent finance domain and production model experience.

job.title: Junior Data Scientist - Equipment Reliability
job.description: Use Python, SQL and pandas to investigate maintenance events, process anomaly signals and reliability patterns. Develop interpretable scikit-learn baselines and explain error patterns to operations teams. Fully remote within Germany.

jobs.notes: Strong industrial context and direct overlap with tabular modeling and engineering communication.

job.title: Graduate Data Scientist - Industrial Quality
job.description: Develop Python and scikit-learn defect models using manufacturing measurements. Hybrid work in Paris with the local factory analytics team.

jobs.notes: Strong role fit but Paris-based hybrid location is not in the accepted list.

job.title: Junior Data Scientist - ERP Quality Analytics
job.description: Build Python and SQL industrial-quality reports and integrate them with SAP production data. Use scikit-learn to test selected anomaly baselines. Hybrid in Berlin.

jobs.notes: Otherwise compatible posting includes a consciously excluded technology.

job.title: Senior Data Scientist - Predictive Maintenance
job.description: Lead Python equipment-failure modeling, mentor junior scientists and own senior-level reliability-ML decisions. Hybrid in Stuttgart.

jobs.notes: Otherwise suitable industrial ML position but explicitly senior.

job.title: Junior Data Scientist - Retail Forecasting
job.description: Build Python demand-forecasting baselines with pandas and scikit-learn for a retail planning team. Apply statistical evaluation and communicate forecast errors. Industry forecasting experience is helpful but not required. Hybrid in Munich.

jobs.notes: Transfers tabular and statistical skills, but retail context and specialized forecasting are new.

job.title: Junior Embedded Firmware Engineer
job.description: Implement C and C++ firmware for factory sensor hardware and use Python scripts only for device testing. No data-analysis or machine-learning responsibilities. Hybrid in Stuttgart.

jobs.notes: Relevant industrial context and searchable required keyword, but outside all preferred role families.

job.title: Junior Machine Learning Engineer - NLP Applications
job.description: Build Python text-processing services with PyTorch, Transformers and Docker. Create evaluation suites for language models and collaborate with engineers on production APIs. Hybrid in Munich; training is available for junior hires.

jobs.notes: Matches entry-level role and basic Python, but evidence for NLP frameworks and production APIs is absent.

job.title: Junior Data Scientist - R Statistical Methods
job.description: Perform manufacturing statistics with R, tidyverse, ggplot2 and SQL. Maintain established R Markdown analyses and reporting workflows. Fully remote within Germany.

jobs.notes: Otherwise compatible role; mandatory candidate-stack keyword is absent from searchable job data.

job.title: Junior Data Scientist - Model Approval Operations
job.description: Coordinate approval tickets for prebuilt Python and scikit-learn reports created by another team. Copy performance figures to governance templates, arrange review meetings and manage documentation; no modeling or statistical analysis is part of the role. Hybrid in Stuttgart.

jobs.notes: Lexical decoy: a compatible title and matching technical vocabulary, but administrative work only.

job.title: Junior Data Scientist - Industrial Quality
job.description: Develop Python, pandas and SQL analyses of production-defect patterns. Use statistical process control, scikit-learn baselines and root-cause reasoning alongside factory engineers. The team is hybrid in Stuttgart.

jobs.notes: Directly combines demonstrated production-quality experience, statistical analysis and portfolio ML.

job.title: Junior Data Analyst - Production Yield
job.description: Analyze manufacturing yield using Python, SQL and Power BI. Investigate defect trends, document statistical process control indicators and present findings to quality engineers. Hybrid team in Berlin.

jobs.notes: Very strong first data-role transition using existing professional domain and analytics experience.

job.title: Junior Data Scientist - Client Workshops
job.description: Analyze production data in Python and scikit-learn. German C1 is required for client workshops, plant visits and written stakeholder reports. Hybrid in Munich.

jobs.notes: Hard German C1 requirement exceeds the synthetic candidate German B1 level.

job.title: Junior Data Analyst - Product Experimentation
job.description: Use Python, SQL and descriptive statistics to assess product A/B tests, validate experiment datasets and communicate uncertainty to stakeholders. Reporting work is shared with product analysts. Fully remote in Germany.

jobs.notes: Relevant quantitative and reporting skills but no documented professional experimentation history.

job.title: Graduate Machine Learning Engineer - Equipment Monitoring
job.description: Develop Python equipment-anomaly baselines with scikit-learn for clients during a six-month contractor-only engagement. Fully remote in Germany.

jobs.notes: Role and technical scope fit; employment is exclusively contract rather than requested full-time.

job.title: Junior Data Scientist - Onsite Factory Team
job.description: Use Python and scikit-learn to analyze equipment failures. This role requires five days each week onsite in Stuttgart with no remote or hybrid option.

jobs.notes: Explicitly onsite-only arrangement conflicts with hard remote/hybrid preference.

job.title: Junior Data Analyst - Marketing Insights
job.description: Use Python, SQL and pandas to maintain campaign-performance analyses and explain marketing attribution dashboards. Some regression analysis is useful. Hybrid in Berlin.

jobs.notes: General analytics transfers; domain-specific attribution methods and marketing experience are absent.

job.title: Graduate Data Scientist - Logistics Optimization
job.description: Analyze supply-chain process data in Python and SQL, model shipment delay risks with scikit-learn and prototype simple optimization analyses. Prior operations knowledge is welcome. Hybrid in Stuttgart.

jobs.notes: Manufacturing process insight and tabular modeling transfer, but logistics and optimization are not proven.

job.title: Junior Data Analyst - Reporting Migration
job.description: Migrate existing manufacturing KPI dashboards into a new reporting system. Read Python and SQL extracts written by other teams, map historical Power BI definitions and validate presentation formatting; no new analysis or model development. Hybrid in Berlin.

jobs.notes: Lexical and industrial-domain decoy: compatibility with hard filters but largely mechanical migration.
